# FilmGeezer

> FilmGeezer is a public entertainment discovery website for movies, TV series, anime, and K-dramas.

Canonical site: https://filmgeezer.site/

## Primary public pages

- [Home](https://filmgeezer.site/) — FilmGeezer discovery home.
- [Movies](https://filmgeezer.site/movies) — movie discovery and recommendations.
- [TV Series](https://filmgeezer.site/tv) — TV discovery and recommendations.
- [Anime](https://filmgeezer.site/anime) — anime movie and series discovery.
- [K-Drama](https://filmgeezer.site/k-drama) — Korean movie and series discovery.
- [About](https://filmgeezer.site/about) — what FilmGeezer is and its data-source credits.
- [Contact & Support](https://filmgeezer.site/contact) — FilmGeezer support.
- [Privacy](https://filmgeezer.site/privacy) — privacy information.
- [Terms](https://filmgeezer.site/terms) — terms of use.

## Notes

- FilmGeezer title-detail URLs use `/media/movie/{tmdbId}` or `/media/tv/{tmdbId}`.
- `/search`, `/watchlist`, `/account`, `/notifications`, authentication routes, and the administrator application are not intended as public reference/index pages.
- Entertainment data uses TMDB; streaming-provider availability shown through TMDB is powered by JustWatch. Selected anime character information may be supplemented by AniList.

For a longer machine-readable overview, see:
https://filmgeezer.site/llms-full.txt
